lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I have something to discuss with you.
I'm busy at the moment, so I'll listen to it later.
Whatever you're going to say, I agree with all of it.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I know you're not busy right now.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Rapi just told me about it.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I know you pretty well and how you'll react to things,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: but I still want to hear your opinion.
Sure. What is it?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Eunhwa really chewed me out a second ago.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: She said my skirt was too short,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: and that just looking at it made her feel cold.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I'm supposed to lengthen it to knee-length too!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Jeez, you should have seen her scowl!
I can certainly imagine.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: But, I think short skirts

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: are easy to move around in

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: and they look really good on me!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: What do you think, Commander?
I think you look perfect just the way you are.
You should wear longer skirts only when it's cold.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Hehe, thanks!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I like the way I look too.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Aw, come on!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I just can't bear to part with cuteness, even in this chilly weather!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: But oh dear, I can already hear Eunhwa's voice in my head. What should I do? T_T
Why don't you suggest to Eunhwa that she wear a skirt?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Oooh,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: that'd be fun!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Speaking of which, she hates them

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: and would never try one out herself!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: But if she gives it a shot this time,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: she might just find herself head over heels for it!
Just don't mention that it was my idea.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Haha, it'll be fine ^__^

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I'll tell her that you really want to see her in a skirt.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Ah, here she comes now!
Emmmaaaa!!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: See you next time, Commander ^__^
